project.title: anaerobic wastewater digester sludge
project.description: Samples from an anaerobic wastewater digester were grown in the laboratory in a defined medium containing phosphite (HPO3) as the sole electron donor and carbon dioxide (CO2) as the sole electron acceptor in an effort to identify new microorganisms capable of coupling phosphite oxidation to carbon fixation.
